name: Fully Welded Plate Heat Exchanger
full_description: A fully welded plate heat exchanger uses a permanently welded corrugated plate pack instead of gasketed heat-transfer channels. The structure improves containment for demanding fluids while retaining compact plate heat-transfer performance for petrochemical, refining, chemical, pharmaceutical, power, geothermal, and high-purity process duties.
advantage: Gasket-free heat-transfer core reduces external leakage points and gasket replacement work.
Welded corrugated plate channels deliver high heat-transfer efficiency in a compact footprint.
Suitable for hazardous, high-value, corrosive, high-pressure, and high-temperature media when matched with proper materials.
Lower routine maintenance demand supports continuous process lines.
CIP cleaning and inspection planning can be matched to the fouling behavior of the process fluid.
Material options support stainless steel, titanium, Hastelloy, and other corrosion-resistant alloys.

technical_parameters.Materials: Stainless steel, titanium, Hastelloy, and other corrosion-resistant alloys
technical_parameters.Core sealing: No gaskets in the heat-transfer core
technical_parameters.Design pressure: Up to 40 bar; special designs up to 100 bar
technical_parameters.Typical applications: Petrochemical, refining, chemical, pharmaceutical, power, geothermal, and high-purity duties

details.title: When to select it
details.content: Select this design when leakage containment, high pressure, high temperature, corrosion resistance, or reduced gasket maintenance matters more than full mechanical access to every channel.

details.title: Engineering focus
details.content: A project should confirm pressure rating, temperature program, material compatibility, thermal expansion, cleaning method, welding quality requirements, and final hydrostatic testing.
